digest.component_or_area: local LLM configuration and developer gates
propositions: Local developer gates (review-plan, review-code, verify-completion) must resolve their LLM model classes to Bedrock inference profiles instead of direct Anthropic endpoints, configured via REBAR_LLM_CONFIG_FILE using a layered config file rather than the deprecated bare REBAR_LLM_MODEL.

All three local gates must execute end-to-end against Bedrock on real tickets with parseable verdicts and structured output validation, with zero direct-Anthropic calls and all calls resolvable via provider-clean usage logs.
Prompt caching must engage on the Bedrock path with nonzero cache_read_tokens observed across gate runs, not merely cache_write, to confirm the caching mechanism works on Bedrock inference profiles.
The opt-in to Bedrock and the revert back to Anthropic must both be documented in docs/local-dev-env.md and the revert must be executable in one step (unsetting a single environment variable).

Bedrock's cachePoint TTL behavior must be verified and any observable differences from Anthropic's cache_control TTL documented, including evidence that the default 5-minute TTL is equivalent on both providers.
No changes under infra/ directory are permitted, and all lint, typecheck, and gate exit codes must pass with green status on the modified tree.
